name: Odd
title: Of the Nursery
examine: He has set more trees than the town has felled, which is the only boast he has ever made, and he made it to a seedling.
lines: Sixty years for a saw log. I will not see one of these. That is the arrangement.
Every wain that goes out owes seedlings back. Ebba counts the boards. I count the beds.
The row by the walk is from the year of the ice. Look how crooked. They grew scared.
